_comment: Callouts that are not combos. defense: called after a combo in Defense mode, like the opponent's return. 'after' lists what the combo's LAST strike must be for this defense to fit, matched against that strike's category (jab, cross, hook, uppercut, teep, leadKick, rearKick, highKick, knee, elbow), weapon (punch, kick, knee, elbow, clinch), range (kicking, punching, close, clinch; boxing inside, outside), level (head, body, leg), or weapon-level (kick-leg, kick-body, kick-head) — see data/strikes.json. 'sports' limits a move to those sports; leave it out for all three. When nothing fits, any move for the sport is used.
_comment_footwork: Footwork mode adds one move to each combo, said as part of it: an entry before the first strike ('before' keys match the FIRST strike) or an exit after the last ('after' keys match the LAST strike), using the same keys as defense. actions is how much extra execution time the move gets, in strikes (1 = one strike's worth). Every name must be classified as footwork by data/strikes.json.
